<h1>dockerfiler</h1>

[Build dockerfile straight from R.]{.gv-pkg-tagline}

The goal of `{dockerfiler}` is to provide an easy way to create Dockerfiles from R. You can use `{dockerfiler}` to programatically create a Dockerfile.

## Install

```r
# From CRAN
install.packages("dockerfiler")

# Development version
pak::pak("thinkr-open/dockerfiler")
```
:::
